rule: Every site type requires a distinct architectural base for each biome while preserving a shared gameplay footprint and interaction anchor.

campaign_local.bobo: gentrified storefront or former cafe/community local, broad window, bicycle/notice-board cues
campaign_local.banlieue: ground-floor local in apartment block, simple storefront, roller shutter and concrete/enduit cues
campaign_local.periurbain: small office in retail/artisan strip, light cladding, parking/functional frontage
campaign_local.campagne: former village shop or small maison-de-bourg, stone/render, shutters and planter
campaign_local.retraites: well-kept association pavilion/local, light facade, awning, hedges and planters
campaign_local.riches: elegant stone ground-floor office, refined frames, brass/wood details, restrained awning

financement.bobo: small coworking/fundraising storefront with modern interior
financement.banlieue: practical association/accounting office at ground floor
financement.riches: small premium consulting/finance office in stone/glass

communication.bobo: creative media studio with compact rooftop antenna
communication.banlieue: technical/media local attached to apartment block with mast/dish
communication.periurbain: industrial media/technical unit with compact mast and equipment
communication.campagne: local radio/repeater building with slim mast
communication.retraites: well-kept community communication local with discreet antenna
communication.riches: elegant media agency with discreet integrated dishes/screens

security_admin_slot.bobo: small urban multipurpose local with storefront and side storage
security_admin_slot.banlieue: storage/association ground-floor unit with shutter and service door
security_admin_slot.periurbain: small logistics office/hangar with loading cues
security_admin_slot.campagne: municipal annex/former workshop with traditional materials
security_admin_slot.riches: elegant annex/service office with refined frontage

meeting_hall.periurbain: municipal multipurpose hall near commercial/industrial area

polling_institute.bobo: creative research/survey studio with glass frontage and screens
polling_institute.periurbain: study office in small tertiary/business park
polling_institute.campagne: survey office in converted municipal/commercial local
polling_institute.retraites: tidy survey/research office near municipal context
